items.name: shares.links
items.label: Create share links
items.description: Create public links to files and folders they manage (only while share links are enabled in Settings → Sharing).

items.name: users.manage
items.label: Manage accounts
items.description: Create, edit, disable, enable, unlock and delete accounts and give them roles: Member, Guest and the roles an administrator allows — never accounts or roles with server permissions this role does not have.
items.warning: Can delete accounts together with their personal files, and create accounts with a password they choose.
